about: Presses that do nothing ON PURPOSE, for scripts/check-dead-clicks-live.mjs. One entry per press: `page` (the sidebar row, « Settings › Page », or * for any), then `dk` (its data-kb) or `match` (the start of its label), and `why`. A dead click that is a bug is fixed, not listed here.

allow.why: re-reads the colour scheme (it bumps a revision counter): nothing to show when the scheme did not change
